title: New ophthalmic dual-viscoelastic device in cataract surgery: a comparative study

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial (CC BY-NC 4.0) license', link http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/); not CC BY, record kept private

indication: Cataract with lens opacity reducing visual quality; ECC below 1200 cells/mm2, glaucoma or IOP above 24 mmHg, hypermature cataract, ocular comorbidity limiting VA, previous refractive surgery, pseudoexfoliation or zonular weakness, dense cataract preventing optical biometry and axial length of 20.00 mm or less or 26.00 mm or more excluded

groups.description: OVD1 (Group 1): Viscopack14, the new dual-OVD under evaluation (dispersive BiVisc for the anterior chamber and capsulorhexis, cohesive Ocu+ 1.4% for IOL implantation); coaxial phacoemulsification (Infiniti OZil, bimanual cracking, standardized fluidics) through a 2.2-mm clear corneal incision, in-bag IOL, OVD removed by I/A; single surgeon; dexamethasone/netilmicin 2 weeks then bromfenac 2 weeks
OVD2 (Group 2): DuoVisc, the established dual-OVD used as comparator (dispersive Viscoat, cohesive ProVisc), same surgeon, technique and aftercare

series.baseline_label: Baseline CCT at the inclusion visit (Table 2 'CCT (microns)' Mean (SD), column OVD1); optical low-coherence reflectometry (OLCR) ocular biometer
series.notes: Reference from Table 2, follow-ups from Table 3 rows 'CCT (microns)' at 24 hours (hours/730.5), 7, 45 and 90 days (days/30.4375); mean (±SD) in µm; CCT by OLCR ocular biometer (method 'other'); all 50 eyes completed the study (no dropouts)

series.baseline_label: Baseline CCT at the inclusion visit (Table 2 'CCT (microns)' Mean (SD), column OVD2); optical low-coherence reflectometry (OLCR) ocular biometer

notes: Prospective randomised double-blind controlled study; one eye per patient; 50 eyes per arm (127 assessed, screening stopped at the 100th enrolled patient); all recruited patients completed the study.
Role: Viscopack14 is the new device evaluated against DuoVisc used as comparator (Introduction), so Viscopack14 is treated and DuoVisc control.

Method: CCT was measured with an optical low-coherence reflectometry (OLCR) ocular biometry device (model not named), which is not ultrasound, AS-OCT, Scheimpflug, specular or confocal; recorded as 'other'.

Ambiguity flagged for review: the Results text reports a 24-hour CCT change from baseline per group (in µm and %) that does not equal the difference between the Table 3 24-hour mean and the Table 2 baseline mean of the same group. The protocol requires table cells, which are cited unchanged; the source of the discrepancy is not stated.
